description: This file defines extension methods for the Socket class, providing functionality to enable TCP loopback fast path and keep-alive options, primarily for Windows platforms.

classes.name: SocketExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for the Socket class to enable fast path and keep-alive features.

methods.name: EnableFastPath
methods.description: Enables TCP Loopback Fast Path on a socket if running on Windows 8 or later, to improve performance.

methods.name: EnableKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables TCP KeepAlive on a socket with configurable timing parameters.
